firstPlayerRule: The player to the dealer’s left plays first, then play continues around the table.
houseFallback: The page does not say who deals; use the picker to choose the first dealer.
clarifications: The dealer turns up a starter card. If it is an eight, it is buried in the pack and the next card is turned.

sources.title: Crazy Eights — How to Play

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Crazy Eights page in a browser. "The Play": "Starting to the dealer’s left, each player must place one card face up on the starter pile."
uncertainty: The page does not say how the first dealer is chosen.
